title: Live dashboard of findings, decisions and savings
statement: A public dashboard shows findings, decisions and reasons, before and after numbers, time saved, and a current and historical bottleneck heat map.

criteria.then: it passes the versioned data contract the page relies on
it has one row per stage, hottest first, and one column per week, so past and present bottlenecks show
each decision carries its finding, decision, reason and before and after numbers, newest first

criteria.given: adopted, rejected and inconclusive decisions and the agent overhead
criteria.then: only adopted decisions count, on the critical path, net of overhead
it has a panel for every section of dashboard.json and re-fetches it every 60 seconds
it runs through the same pipeline and is labelled as sample data
